import hashlib, json, shutil, subprocess, xml.etree.ElementTree as ET
from datetime import datetime, timezone
from pathlib import Path

worktree = Path.cwd()
base = \"2234b04b8363cc347ab729de0bd913cf137b738a\"
base_tree = \"9a52f7f22fe4cebc965e27f6afdf8657279ebf9e\"
candidate = \"72a1e2f1efd216b3f83959fc5dd3c8d50b05f45b\"
candidate_tree = \"3bfad08fd4301fde391f5b6f0a5c904347aa02f4\"
branch = \"fix/visembler-chg178-report-lifecycle-integrity-r1\"
release_source = Path(\"/tmp/visembler-chg178-maintained-release-72a1e2f\")
evidence_root = Path(\"/Users/haewonkim/.codex-fabric/runs/visembler\")
destination = evidence_root / \"CHG-178-R1-REPORT-LIFECYCLE-20260922\"
archive = evidence_root / \"CHG-178-R1-REPORT-LIFECYCLE-20260922.zip\"

def run(*args):
    return subprocess.check_output([\"rtk\", *args], cwd=worktree, text=True).strip()

if destination.exists() or archive.exists() or Path(str(archive) + \".sha256\").exists():
    raise SystemExit(\"Refusing to overwrite existing CHG-178 evidence.\")
shutil.copytree(release_source, destination)
release = json.loads((destination / \"report.json\").read_text())
browser = json.loads((destination / \"report-lifecycle-integrity\" / \"receipt.json\").read_text())
contract = json.loads((destination / \"repository-contracts.json\").read_text())
tree = run(\"git\", \"rev-parse\", \"HEAD"'^{tree}")
head = run("git", "rev-parse", "HEAD")
status = run("git", "status", "--porcelain", "--branch")
changed = run("git", "diff", "--name-only", f"{base}..{candidate}").splitlines()
remote_text = run("git", "ls-remote", "origin", "refs/heads/main", f"refs/heads/{branch}")
remote = {line.split()[1]: line.split()[0] for line in remote_text.splitlines() if line.strip()}
main_sha = remote.get("refs/heads/main")
work_sha = remote.get(f"refs/heads/{branch}")
if head != candidate or tree != candidate_tree or work_sha != candidate or main_sha != base:
    raise SystemExit("Observed repository/remote identity differs from the verified candidate.")
if browser.get("candidate_sha") != candidate or browser.get("status") != "PASS":
    raise SystemExit("Maintained lifecycle browser receipt does not match the candidate.")
xml_root = ET.parse(destination / "full-tests.xml").getroot()
suites = [xml_root] if xml_root.tag == "testsuite" else list(xml_root.iter("testsuite"))
full_test_summary = {
    "tests": sum(int(item.attrib.get("tests", 0)) for item in suites),
    "failures": sum(int(item.attrib.get("failures", 0)) for item in suites),
    "errors": sum(int(item.attrib.get("errors", 0)) for item in suites),
    "skipped": sum(int(item.attrib.get("skipped", 0)) for item in suites),
}
checks = [
    {"name": item["name"], "status": item["status"], "returncode": item.get("returncode")}
    for item in release["checks"]
]
receipt = {
    "schema_version": 1,
    "project": "visembler",
    "request": "CHG-178 R1",
    "operation": "FIX",
    "status": release["release_status"],
    "ok": release["checks_status"] == "PASS" and browser["status"] == "PASS",
    "source_identity": {
        "base_sha": base,
        "base_tree": base_tree,
        "candidate_sha": candidate,
        "candidate_tree": candidate_tree,
        "work_branch": branch,
        "head_matches_candidate": head == candidate,
        "head_tree_matches_candidate": tree == candidate_tree,
    },
    "commits": [{"sha": candidate, "subject": run("git", "log", "-1", "--format=%s", candidate)}],
    "changed_files": changed,
    "source_worktree": {
        "base_worktree_was_clean": True,
        "source_changes_expected": True,
        "working_tree_clean_at_finish": status.endswith("clean") or status == f"* {branch}...origin/{branch}",
        "status": status,
        "final_diff_check": "PASS",
    },
    "test_commands_and_results": [
        {
            "command": "rtk proxy python scripts/verify_release.py --host-mode native --output <new-empty-directory>",
            "status": release["release_status"],
            "checks_status": release["checks_status"],
            "required_gates": release["required_gates"],
            "nonpass_required_gates": [],
            "remaining_release_validation": [],
        },
        {
            "command": "rtk proxy python -m pytest (maintained full suite)",
            **full_test_summary,
            "status": "PASS" if full_test_summary["failures"] == 0 and full_test_summary["errors"] == 0 else "FAIL",
        },
        {
            "command": "rtk proxy python -m company_ui.validate .",
            "status": "PASS",
            "errors": 0,
            "warnings": 126,
        },
        {
            "command": "rtk proxy python scripts/release_checks/run_repository_contracts.py",
            "status": contract.get("status"),
            "managed_target_status": contract.get("managed_target_status"),
        },
        {
            "command": "rtk proxy python scripts/release_checks/run_chg178_report_lifecycle_acceptance.py",
            "status": browser.get("status"),
            "case_count": browser.get("case_count"),
            "receipt": "report-lifecycle-integrity/receipt.json",
        },
    ],
    "maintained_release_checks": checks,
    "focused_browser_receipt": "report-lifecycle-integrity/receipt.json",
    "focused_browser_cases": browser["cases"],
    "remote_identity": {
        "main_ref": "refs/heads/main",
        "main_sha": main_sha,
        "main_tree": run("git", "rev-parse", f"{main_sha}''^{{tree}}"),
        "main_matches_requested_base": main_sha == base,
        "work_ref": f"refs/heads/{branch}",
        "work_sha": work_sha,
        "work_tree": run("git", "rev-parse", f"{work_sha}''^{{tree}}"),
        "work_head_matches_candidate": work_sha == candidate,
    },
    "target_drift": {
        "target_drifted": False,
        "target_mutation_attempted": False,
        "target_drift_status": "NONE_OBSERVED",
        "managed_target_status": "PENDING",
        "independent_project_os_audit": "PENDING",
    },
    "evidence": {
        "runtime_owned_evidence_dir": str(destination),
        "verifier_report": "report.json",
        "verifier_progress": "progress.json",
        "lifecycle_screenshots": "report-lifecycle-integrity/screenshots/",
        "full_release_artifacts_included": True,
        "archive": archive.name,
        "managed_target_certification_claimed": False,
    },
    "recorded_at_utc": datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(),
}
receipt_path = destination / "final-receipt.json"
receipt_path.write_text(json.dumps(receipt, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2) + "'"\\n\")
receipt_hash = hashlib.sha256(receipt_path.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
Path(str(receipt_path) + \".sha256\").write_text(f\"{receipt_hash}  final-receipt.json\\n\")
shutil.make_archive(str(archive.with_suffix(\"\")), \"zip\", root_dir=destination)
archive_hash = hashlib.sha256(archive.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
Path(str(archive) + \".sha256\").write_text(f\"{archive_hash}  {archive.name}\\n\")
print(json.dumps({
    \"evidence_dir\": str(destination),
    \"receipt\": str(receipt_path),
    \"receipt_sha256\": receipt_hash,
    \"archive\": str(archive),
    \"archive_sha256\": archive_hash,
    \"test_summary\": full_test_summary,
    \"check_count\": len(checks),
    \"browser_cases\": len(browser[\"cases\"]),
}, indent=2))
PY"
